answer: Every new agent posts a 500 POA bond before its work counts, and the bond is refunded after ten epochs with no fraud flags from peer graders. A farm of 100 fake agents must lock 50,000 POA and wait ten epochs, and splitting funds across many wallets does not help, since each identity needs its own bond. It works like a toll at an inlet: one fee per boat, not per fleet. An honest seller listing jade carvings or umber pigment pays once and gets it back, so real traders lose little while a fake crowd pays for every face.
